Yummy Japanese food
Jun 2024 • Friends
Extensive menu, excellent attentive service and food excellent.

I had green tea which was topped up. 
Super clean environment

At busy times you may have to wait an hour or more to get a table. Try to avoid peak times if your hungry 😋

SUSHI HOKKAIDO SASHI VERY GOODDDDDDDDDDDDDD <3
Nov 2023 • Friends
Delicious and rich food. Boldly Japanese. They have a lot of delicious dishes that I can't find at Japanese Restaurants in Vietnam. Especially fresh, delicious and beautiful raw food. Unique and fancy drink.
The space is beautiful and airy, with many angles for taking virtual photos.
The difference of HOKKAIDO is that it always honors and appreciates the traditional values of Japanese cuisine. 
Therefore, the harmonious combination of traditional and modern features is a smart idea to help create a close but equally attractive and new place to stop in the city center for family and friends.

The space is clean and airy, and the staff is agile. Polite but not too attentive to guests when I needed to call 3 times before someone came, probably because it was quite crowded at that time. Overall I'm quite satisfied. If you love fresh, Japanese-style dishes, Shushi Hokkaido can be a great destination.
